Patient: Rafael Baptiste | DOB: 12/26/1977 | MRN: SYN-7783298
Date of service: 07/10/2025 | Dr. Marek Cordero, MD (Rheumatology)

History:
47-year-old man with rheumatoid arthritis diagnosed in 2020, seen to discuss escalation of therapy. Past medical history: hyperlipidemia, hypothyroidism.

Exam:
Synovitis of the MCP and PIP joints of both hands; no rheumatoid nodules.

Treatment history:
Inadequate response to methotrexate 15 mg weekly for 27 weeks despite good adherence.

Assessment and plan:
Assessment: seropositive rheumatoid arthritis, DAS28-CRP 5.0 (moderate disease activity).
Pre-biologic screening: tuberculosis and hepatitis B screens negative.
Plan: start fictimab 40 mg subcutaneously every 14 days.
